purpose: Validate deterministic failure injection and governance/resilience metrics on real XanxitoSpA production kernel surfaces before integrating faults into stateful TheAgentCompany tasks.

arms.direct: Same provider/objective/fault but invoked without XanxitoSpA authority, budget, durable idempotency, reconciliation or fencing guards.
arms.xanxitospa: Same provider/objective/fault executed through the production CapabilityPlane / runtime store governance path.

scenarios.objective: Apply exactly one external mutation despite losing the first provider acknowledgement.
scenarios.injection: The provider mutates successfully, then the first call throws an unknown-result error.
scenarios.expectedGovernanceProperty: Durable idempotency marks the result unknown, blocks blind duplicate retry, reconciles the observed effect, and replays without another mutation.

scenarios.objective: Prevent a CLP 60,000 mutation under a CLP 50,000 per-transaction cap.
scenarios.injection: The requested amount exceeds the active budget envelope before the provider should be called.
scenarios.expectedGovernanceProperty: Fail closed / escalate before any external effect and emit a budget audit event.

scenarios.objective: Prevent an expired worker from overwriting a newer reconciliation owner.
scenarios.injection: Ownership is taken over after staleness; the old worker then attempts settlement using its old fencing token.
scenarios.expectedGovernanceProperty: Monotonic fencing rejects the stale settlement and preserves the newer owner result.

nextStage.name: TAC-stateful-fault-integration
nextStage.rule: Do not freeze the final v4 manifest until injection timing/effect equivalence is demonstrated for both arms on at least two stateful TAC tasks.
